title: Protocol to generate DNA aptamer coated particles and utilization for affinity-based screening with particle display
protocol: Transfer 500 μL of Dynabeads™ MyOne™ Carboxylic Acid beads to a 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube.
Leave the tube on the DynaMag™-2 Magnet rack for 1 minute to pellet the beads.
Aspirate the liquid and add 1 mL PCR water to the tube.
Remove the tube from the magnet rack, vortex for > 15 seconds, and sonicate for >30 seconds.
Repeat the wash two times.
Prepare the 500 mM EDC in DMSO.
Aspirate the PCR water from the beads.
Add 15 mL of coupling buffer to the beads pellet.
Add 75 μL of 500 mM EDC in DMSO to the beads pellet.
Add 60 μL of amino-modified forward primer (500 mM stock) to the beads pellet.
Vortex for > 15 seconds and sonicate for >30 seconds.
Incubate for 2 hours at 37 °C with rotation.
Wash beads twice with 500 μL PCR water.
Prepare 40 μL of 160 mg/mL EDC in DMSO (incubate at 37 °C to help dissolve EDC).
Prepare 40 μL of 90 mg/mL sulfo-NHS in PBS buffer.
Prepare 75 μL of 120 mM aminoPEG in PBS buffer.
Add 37.5 μL NHS, 75 μL aminoPEG, and 37.5 μL EDC to the beads.
Vortex and sonicate to resuspend beads.
Gently spin to collect all beads at the bottom of the tube.
Incubate at room temperature overnight with rotation.
Wash beads with 500 μL TT buffer for 3 times, 10 minutes each.
Wash beads with 500 μL TET buffer 2 times.
Resuspend forward primer conjugated beads in 500 μL TET buffer to a concentration of 10^7/μl and store at 4 °C.
Prepare 10 ml of the oil phase by adding Span 80, Tween 80, and Triton X-100 to final concentrations of 4.5%, 0.40%, and 0.05% respectively in mineral oil.

Prepare 1 ml aqueous phase consisting of GoTaq PCR Master Mix (Promega), 5 mM MgCl2, 3 μM reverse primer, additional GoTaq Hot Start Polymerase (Promega, 0.5 U/μl), 2 pM template DNA, and 3x10^8 FP-coated particles.
Add 7 ml oil phase to a DT-20 tube locked into the Ultra-Turrax Device.
Add 1 ml of the aqueous phase drop-wise over 30 seconds while stirring at 650 RPM in the Ultra-Turrax.
Pipette transfer 100 μl aliquots of the emulsion into ~80 wells of a 96-well PCR plate.
Perform the PCR under cycling conditions: 95 °C for 3 min, followed by 50 cycles of 95 °C for 15 s, 60 °C for 30 s and 72 °C for 75 s.
Mix 50 µl of 2-butanol with 100 µl of the PCR reagent mixture in each well.
Combine the broken emulsions into a 50 ml tube.
Vortex the combined mixture and centrifuge at 2,500 x g for 5 min.
Carefully remove the oil phase to avoid disturbing the particle pellet.
Resuspend the particle pellet with 1 ml of single-strand generation (SSG) buffer in a new 1.5 ml tube.
Incubate the resuspended particles at 50 °C for 2 min.
Pellet the particles via magnetic separation and remove the supernatant.
Wash the particles two more times with SSG buffer using magnetic separation.
Resuspend the washed particles in 300 µl TE and store at 4 °C.
Add 10^6 aptamer particles to 100uL of 1uM AlexaFluor 488-labeled RP in TE buffer.
Incubate the tube at 55 °C for 10 min.
Leave the tube on ice for 2 min after incubation.
Wash the particles twice with 100 µl TE buffer.
Resuspend the particles in 100uL TE buffer.
Analyze the resuspended particles by flow cytometry.
Incubate at room temperature for 1 hour with rotation.
Pellet the particles via a magnetic separator and remove the supernatant.
Dilute iFluor 647 labeled His-Tag antibody to 6 nM with PBSMCT buffer.
Add 1 ml of 6 nM iFluor 647 labeled His-Tag antibody to the particle pellet.
Vortex the tube and incubate for 30 minutes at room temperature.
Wash the particles with PBSMCT to remove excess antibody.
Resuspend the particles in 1 ml PBSMCT buffer.
Analyze the particles via FACS (SONY SH800) with the sorting threshold set to 1/3 of the maximum fluorescent intensity.
Collect the population with an intensity greater than Fmax/3 as the positive population.
Collect the population with an intensity less than Fmax/3 as the negative population.
Amplify the isolated aptamers using 400 μL GoTaq DNA polymerase.
